text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaalllright!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Umm! About the weight on the barbell, I 
feel like I can lift even more!
choice_data_list:
Then shall we add more weight plates 
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

Training with Yukino Bijin toward her 
debut race was progressing smoothly.

The girls who enter Tracen Academy 
naturally possess great potential. She is 
no exception, possessing truly wonderful 
abilities.
choice_data_list:
You've got plenty of power, that's for 
sure.
You've got plenty of power, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You think so? Ehehe~...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back in the village I used to help with 
shoveling snow and farm work, so maybe 
that's why!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A'ight then, I'm gonna go change! I can't 
be goin' into a cafe dressed like this!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Cafe?
(Sparkle, sparkle...!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Good work, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: C-C-C-C-C-C-C-City-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You always give such great reactions.

Gold City. Famous for being an 
exceptionally "beautiful" Umamusume, she 
also works as a model. Her skills are 
undeniable, having even won a G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still, you're used to it by now, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How could I get used to this?! The person 
from the magazine is standing right in 
front of me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"There are Umamusume this cool in the big 
city"... And that's when I truly set my 
heart on heading to Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, even talking like this feels 
like a dream to me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like sudden surprises are still 
gonna spook me for a while yet, huh!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What's that about? Yukino, you're 
seriously hilarious...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, didn't you say you were going to a 
cafe? Which one?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Seattle Cafe"! I'm going shopping with 
Trainer later, and I was hoping you'd come 
with me beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? I was just about to go there 
myself right now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, well then... W-Would you like to join 
me?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa, that was so deee-licious...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's packed with so much fruit! The city's 
so fancy, even their iced tea is stylish, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thanks for the feast, gansu!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you even treated me to food too, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
By the way... How've things been lately, 
Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Lately... um, I've been working hard 
on my training!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah. You're right.

Gold City looks like she wants to say 
something, but Yukino Bijin doesn't seem 
to notice. In that case...
choice_data_list:
From your perspective, how's Yukino been 
lately?

From your perspective, how has Yukino been 
lately?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~! H-How does it look to you, I 
wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's been talking about you lately. 
I heard you even got a fan club.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm mighty grateful for it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Getting attention isn't a bad thing. It's 
just..."

"Gold City! She truly is a "beautiful" 
Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, just do your best and don't worry 
about the others.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If anything happens, you can always talk 
to me about it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City-san is... so kind...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sure it'll be fine! I believe 
in you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If ya put in the grit and give it yer all, 
folks'll surely cheer ya on!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, you're right. If it's Yukino, 
she'll be just fine.

For a moment, I thought Gold City's 
expression clouded over, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm gonna go wash my hands really 
quick~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Thank you for looking out for Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...No. It's not like I did it to get a 
thank you from you or anything."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...That thing she did... I guess that's 
how she truly feels."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That word, "okay."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"People are already talking about me this 
much... and it's not even about my 
running, but my looks."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way she doesn't care at all, 
though.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it... Gold City too...)

text_block_list.text:
Because she was also a model, for a while 
after her debut she drew intense 
attention, both for better and for worse, 
and all sorts of things were said about 
her.

Is it precisely because of that experience 
that she's so drawn to Yukino Bijin, who 
is in a similar situation right now?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Besides... even if I did believe it—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes on Yukino, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I've gotta go now. ...Good luck in 
your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. City-san looks so imposing even 
from behind... So cool.

Though she had hesitated in front of me, 
Gold City remained the picture of a 
dependable senior in front of Yukino 
Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I could ever really become a 
"City Girl" like that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!
